roadmap.title: Start a new save
roadmap.description: Begin a fresh save, beat the tutorial boss Hadern, then pick up the four shells in the first Fallgrim area.

roadmap.title: Finish the Fallgrim side tasks
roadmap.description: Clear the small jobs around Fallgrim and the first regions while you learn the combat.

roadmap.title: Story playthrough with collecting
roadmap.description: Beat the three area bosses and the final boss. Take every lore piece and item in Seat of Infinity before Crucix.

roadmap.title: Clean up in New Game+
roadmap.description: Spend 50,000 tar at the merchant and pick up anything missed.

roadmap.title: Hadern and the Axatana
roadmap.description: Beat Hadern for his shell and the Axatana, upgrade his skill tree, buy the Clockwork Lute, and switch the Axatana forms.

roadmap.title: Virtuous Cycle runs
roadmap.description: Play the add-on mode to return seven seeds and collect its shades, seeds and instincts.

roadmap.title: Shell-less Obsidian run
roadmap.description: On a separate save, renounce humankind and beat the game with no shell.

achievements.description: Beat the game without ever bonding with a shell
achievements.summary: Complete the game while never bonding with any shell.

guide.context: Without a shell you die in one hit, but you have far more stamina. Use the Hallowed Sword throughout.

steps.text: Start the run and never interact with any of the 4 shells. You die in one hit.
Sprint and roll everywhere. You have far more stamina than a shell user, so run past enemies and some bosses.
Beat only the 5 fights that block the story: @enemy{Imrod}, @enemy{Crucix}, @enemy{Enslaved Grisha}, @enemy{Tarsus} and the final boss.
Do this run together with Life is Suffering. Use the shrine from The Nihilist first to get Obsidian Dark Form.
Do not fall to skip ground in @loc{Crypt of Martyrs}. The fall kills you. Take the real path down.

achievements.description: Defeat Hadern in the tutorial
achievements.summary: Defeat Hadern in the tutorial fight at the start of a new game.

guide.context: Hadern copies your own moves: a light swing up close, a thrust from far, and a harden to bait you. This fight is only offered at the start of a new save, not in New Game+.

steps.text: Walk @npc{Hadern} in circles and wait for him to start an attack. Do not swing first, because he can harden and punish you.
When he begins an attack, harden. Then back up and let the attack finish.
Right after his attack ends, run in and hit him. Harden again at once, because he swings back.
Back off and repeat until he falls.

achievements.description: Unlock all secret lore
achievements.summary: Fill in every entry in the lore Compendium by finding all inscriptions and etchings.

guide.context: There are 19 inscriptions and 17 etchings. Etchings are hidden in walls: hit the wall with your weapon to reveal one, and each gives a Glimpse of Wisdom. Lore you have already seen stays in New Game+.

achievements.description: Pick 50 mushrooms
achievements.summary: Pick 50 mushrooms in total.

steps.text: Pick every Weltcap and Tarspore you pass in @loc{Fallgrim}. They grow again after a short wait, so you can pick the same spots again until the count reaches 50.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with bear trap
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy using damage from a bear trap.

steps.text: In the first open forest, go to the tents where several enemies sit. Kill all but one.
Lead the last enemy back and forth over a bear trap until the trap's damage kills it.

achievements.description: Beat the game as an unshelled husk.
achievements.summary: Finish the game in Obsidian Dark Form.

guide.context: Obsidian Dark Form plays like having no shell, with one extra ability that lets you harden in the air for a plunge. It can be earned in the same run as Forever Alone.

steps.text: Use the shrine from The Nihilist to enter Obsidian Dark Form.
Play the whole game in that form and reach the ending.

achievements.description: Waste your life away with Baghead
achievements.summary: Agree to hang out with Baghead forever, which plays the credits.

steps.text: In @loc{Fallgrim}, go right from the entrance into the swamp, past the tunnel where Gorf the frog sits, and take the first path on the left to its end. @npc{Baghead} sits there.
Talk to him and give him a Roasted Rat and a Superior Moonshine when he asks.
Talk to him again and agree to hang out forever. The credits play and the achievement unlocks.
Your save is not affected. When you reload, the game goes back to before you agreed.

achievements.description: Become familiar with all items
achievements.summary: Reach maximum familiarity with every item that has a familiarity level.

guide.context: Use each item the number of times shown to raise its familiarity to maximum. Weapons, equipment, key items and the Glimpse items that already show full familiarity are not needed. The Baguette exists only once per save, so a second copy needs New Game+.

achievements.description: Find your first Shell
achievements.summary: Find your first Shell.

steps.text: Leave the tutorial area, pass through the tunnel, then take the left branch to its dead end. The Harros shell lies there.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy by kicking them off a platform
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy by kicking it off a platform.

steps.text: Unlock the Recollection of Strength ability on a shell.
Kick a normal-size enemy off a ledge so it falls to its death. The kick costs 1 resolve charge.

achievements.displayName: Bring the Glands Back to Me
achievements.description: Deliver a gland to the Old Prisoner.
achievements.summary: Give a gland to the Old Prisoner in Fallgrim Tower.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Imrod}, @enemy{Tarsus} or @enemy{Crucix}. Each drops a gland.
Take the gland to the @npc{Old Prisoner} in @loc{Fallgrim Tower} and hand it over.

achievements.displayName: The Good Time are Killing Me
achievements.description: Join a brigand in a lute session.
achievements.summary: Play a lute next to a brigand who is playing his own lute.

steps.text: Get a lute. You can find one in a chest, take it from an enemy, or buy a Simple Lute from @npc{Vlas} for 600 tar.
Walk slowly up to a brigand in @loc{Fallgrim} who sits on the ground playing a lute.
Use your lute from the inventory so you sit and play at the same time.

achievements.description: Spend over 50, 000 Tar in Vlad's Shop
achievements.summary: Spend more than 50,000 tar in total at Vlas's shop.

guide.context: Spend it all on one save. Wait until you have fully upgraded one shell, so you can also buy from Sester Genessa. In the shell-less run tar has no other use.

steps.text: Earn tar from enemies and tar items. Selling to Vlas is not possible, so you cannot get tar back.
Buy things from @npc{Vlas} until your total spending passes 50,000 tar.

achievements.description: Parry over 100 attacks
achievements.summary: Parry more than 100 enemy attacks.

steps.text: Speak to the @npc{Old Prisoner} at @loc{Fallgrim Tower} and take the Tarnished Seal. With it you can parry.
Parry enemy attacks until you reach 100.

achievements.description: Unlock all of the shells in the game
achievements.summary: Find all 4 Shells in one save.

guide.context: All four shells are in the first Fallgrim area and can be taken right after the tutorial.

steps.text: Find Harros, the Vassal: go left at the first split after the tutorial.

Find Solomon, the Scholar: from @loc{Fallgrim Tower}, take the right door and go into the cave. Beat @enemy{Grisha}, descend the slope behind it, crawl through the hole, beat the next enemy, and take the shell by the torch.

Find Tiel, the Acolyte: from the tower, go left and crawl out of the hole, cross the graveyard, and break the wood over a hole at the cooking pot. Beat @enemy{Ven Noctivagu} and take the shell on the left.

Find Eredrim, the Venerable: from the Solomon room, head right and squeeze through the hole. Keep to the left wall to the stone area leading to a tower, then take the stone path down. The shell leans on a block on the left before the stairs.

achievements.description: Beat every kind of Grisha.
achievements.summary: Defeat the three kinds of Grisha: the normal one, the weak ones, and the Enslaved one.

steps.text: Normal Grisha: beat the miniboss in the Fallgrim cave on the way to the Solomon shell.
Weak Grisha: turn in one gland, ask @npc{Thetus} in @loc{Fallgrim Tower} to switch the fog on, and defeat the two weak Grisha that appear.
Enslaved Grisha: defeat the one that blocks the way out of the Abandonded Chamber in @loc{Crypt of Martyrs}.
Do not harden against a stab. When the Tarnished Seal flashes for an unparryable attack, dodge instead.

achievements.description: Complete the story.
achievements.summary: Finish the game by choosing to ascend after the final boss.

steps.text: Defeat the final boss, then choose to ascend.

achievements.description: Defeat the boss of Shrine of Ash.
achievements.summary: Defeat the boss Imrod, the Unrepentant.

steps.text: Go to the end of @loc{Shrine of Ash} and fight @enemy{Imrod}.
Back away to bait his charge and double club swing. After the second swing he is open, so hit him with a jump attack.
Dodge away from his slams and fire breath.

achievements.description: Defeat the boss of Crypt of Martyrs.
achievements.summary: Defeat the boss Tarsus, the First Martyr.

steps.text: Go to the end of @loc{Crypt of Martyrs} and fight @enemy{Tarsus}.
Stay near the middle of the arena. The outer edge hurts you.
Dodge his three hidden slides at the start instead of hardening.
In phase two, back away from ice spikes when he plants his sword.

achievements.description: Defeat the boss of Seat of Infinity.
achievements.summary: Defeat the boss Crucix, the Twiceborn.

guide.context: Beating Crucix changes Seat of Infinity. Finish collecting its lore and items first.

steps.text: Go to the end of @loc{Seat of Infinity} and choose the chalice to start the fight.
Harden before you land. The chalice drops you through the floor into the arena.
Stay back from his three-swing combos. Wait for a delayed hammer slam before you jump in with a hit.
In phase one his twin shoots at range.

achievements.description: Defeat the final boss.
achievements.summary: Defeat The Unchained, the final boss.

steps.text: Stay close and fight fast. Dodge toward The Unchained when it slides in to swing.
At about half health it calls shell-less copies. They die in one hit, so dodge through the waves.
At about one third health it dives and makes a whirlpool that heals it. Kill some copies or wait it out.

achievements.description: Hit several enemies with one shot.
achievements.summary: Hit and kill at least two enemies with one Ballistazooka bolt.

steps.text: Buy Tools from @npc{Vlas} for 8,000 tar. Use them at the weapon upgrade bench in @loc{Fallgrim Tower} to get the Ballistazooka.
Buy Large Bolts from Vlas for 800 tar each.
Lead two human enemies so one stands behind the other, then fire one shot through both.

achievements.description: Crush an enemy with a plunge.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy by landing on it with a hardened plunge.

steps.text: Make sure your shell has the plunge ability. Obsidian Dark Form has it already.
Jump off a ledge above an enemy, such as the log over a group of humans in @loc{Fallgrim}, and harden while falling. Land on the enemy.

achievements.description: Renounce your humanity.
achievements.summary: Renounce humankind at the shrine in Fallgrim.

steps.text: In @loc{Fallgrim}, go through the swamp past Gorf the frog, and crawl through the hole in the far wall to the shrine.
Interact with the shrine to renounce humankind.
This removes all your shells and their upgrades. Do it on a save you do not need, or after everything else.

achievements.description: Pet the merchant's cat.
achievements.summary: Pet the cat that sits next to the merchant Vlas.

steps.text: Climb the stairs outside @loc{Fallgrim Tower} to @npc{Vlas} and pet the cat next to him.

achievements.description: Spend 100,000 tar in The Virtuous Cycle
achievements.summary: Spend 100,000 tar in The Virtuous Cycle.

steps.text: Play cycles and spend your tar after each area at the Runic Gate. You can also spend it on lutes, pillars and temple entrances.
Spend glimpses at the Runic Gate too. Retain Tar is a good first pick.

achievements.description: Hand over your first seed.
achievements.summary: Give your first seed to Twin Sister in The Virtuous Cycle.

steps.text: Start a cycle. In each area, find a yellow key at a pylon to open the area boss.
Defeat the area boss to get a teleport to the next area. After the last area, fight the final boss.
Complete the cycle to earn a seed, then give it to @npc{Twin Sister}.
Do not spend 5,000 tar to enter a temple. Take a yellow key instead.

achievements.description: Break the cycle.
achievements.summary: Give all seven seeds to Twin Sister to break the Virtuous Cycle.

guide.context: A fast shade, such as Eredrim's with an attack boost, can finish a cycle in about 30 minutes.

steps.text: Complete 7 cycles with any shell and give each seed to @npc{Twin Sister}.
Save a seed to use for Change of Heart. The last handover removes her.

achievements.description: Unlock all Shell Shades for The Virtuous Cycle
achievements.summary: Unlock all three Shell Shades for each of the six characters in The Virtuous Cycle.

guide.context: The minibosses are @enemy{Vim}, @enemy{Grisha}, @enemy{Enslaved Grisha}, @enemy{Ven Noctivagu} and @enemy{Evil Baghead}. Seeds that start near them: 888238 or 767553 for Vim, 195573 for Grisha, and 664561 for Ven and Enslaved Grisha.

steps.text: Harros: kill 60 Brigands, kill @enemy{Vim} 5 times, and complete a cycle.
Solomon: kill 40 Nocteserpers, kill @enemy{Ven Noctivagu} 5 times, and complete a cycle.
Eredrim: kill 20 Faceless Clerics, kill @enemy{Grisha} 5 times, and complete a cycle.
Tiel: kill 40 Slavers of Scorn, kill @enemy{Enslaved Grisha} 3 times, and complete a cycle.
Hadern: kill 100 enemies, kill 10 minibosses, and complete a cycle.
Foundling: reach the first temple, reach the second temple, and complete a cycle.
Do each kill while wearing that shell. To get Hadern, collect an instinct with each base shell and weapon.

achievements.description: Max familiarity with all of the game's lutes
achievements.summary: Reach maximum familiarity with every lute in the game.

guide.context: Do this in the normal world, not inside the cycle. The cycle's lute prices are much higher.

steps.text: Simple Lute: take it from the camp tents after getting the Harros shell, or buy it from @npc{Vlas} for 600 tar.
Impervious Lute: kill the brigand who plays it at the large circular camp and take it.
Clockwork Lute: defeat @npc{Hadern} in the base game, then buy it from him in @loc{Fallgrim Tower} for 5,000 tar.
Play each lute until its familiarity is full.

achievements.description: Acquire 100 instincts in one cycle
achievements.summary: Collect 100 instincts in a single cycle.

steps.text: Collect instincts throughout one cycle until you reach 100.

achievements.description: Return a seed with Hadern in The Virtuous Cycle
achievements.summary: Give a seed to Twin Sister while wearing Hadern's shell.

guide.context: A cycle won as Hadern is not enough. After each cycle you go back to your default armor, so change into Hadern before the handover. Keep a seed unspent, because she leaves after the seventh.

steps.text: Defeat @npc{Hadern} and take his shell from the crypt in the @loc{Fallgrim Tower} hub.
Wear his shell before you speak to @npc{Twin Sister}.
Give her a seed.

achievements.description: Acquire all 4 weapon Instincts for the Axatana in one cycle
achievements.summary: Collect all four weapon instincts for the Axatana in a single cycle.

steps.text: Use the Axatana in a cycle and collect each of its four weapon instincts before the cycle ends.

achievements.description: Complete a run in The Virtuous Cycle with the Dark Form Obsidian Shell Shade
achievements.summary: Complete a cycle using the Obsidian Dark Form Shell Shade.

guide.context: Expect a speed run of about 30 to 40 minutes. Quit to the menu to save, so a failed run can be reloaded.

steps.text: Pick the Obsidian Dark Form shade and start a cycle.
Move fast. You have endless sprint, each instinct gives 100 HP, but life drains all the time and your HP falls to 1 at each teleport.
Use Moonshine, mortal tokens and Weltcaps to survive. A Weltcap respawns each time you leave and re-enter the reverie.
Do not kill a final shade with the axe special. It can stop the next shade from appearing.

achievements.description: Beat all variations of the Dark Shells in The Virtuous Cycle
achievements.summary: Defeat every variation of the Dark Shell final fight in The Virtuous Cycle.

guide.context: Each seed gives a different final fight. Finish all four, because the achievement may not unlock before then.

steps.text: Finish cycles on seed 185744. Harros comes first, then Eredrim and Solomon, then Tiel.
Finish seed 832720. Harros, then Eredrim and Tiel, then Solomon.
Finish seed 767553. Solomon, then Eredrim and Tiel, then Harros.

achievements.description: Fully Upgrade Hadern's skill tree
achievements.summary: Buy every ability in Hadern's skill tree, including one inner ability for each.

guide.context: You get Hadern's shell by beating him. He challenges you beside the mounted weapons after you hold every weapon and shell. The cost in glimpses is large: Sester sells limited Glimpse of Affection and Nascent Tar to cover shortages. The achievement only unlocks once every main ability has an inner ability.

steps.text: Wear Hadern's shell and speak to @npc{Sester Genessa}. Pay 500 tar to learn his name.
Buy all 10 abilities: Accretion of Resolve, Endurance, Ascent, Inheritance, Yearning, Foresight and Dominance, and Recollection of Knowledge, Strength and Death.
Under each ability, also buy one inner ability. Inner abilities cost 250 to 400 tar and 1 to 2 glimpses each.

achievements.description: Transform the Axatana between different modes
achievements.summary: Switch the Axatana between its katana and axe forms.

steps.text: In The Virtuous Cycle, get an instinct with each base weapon so the Axatana is unlocked.
Equip the Axatana and press the two bumper buttons together.
